summary: Legacy HTML form container with an onSubmit signal, hidden from the picker. Use a Group and wire actions explicitly.
description: Form renders an HTML form element around its children and fires `onSubmit` on native submission (e.g. Enter in a field). It is hidden from the node picker; current graphs wire submission explicitly — button `onClick` / input `onEnter` into the action — inside a plain Group, keeping the trigger visible in the graph.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use Group with explicit click/enter wiring instead.
runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: size-mode-dependent layout ports, as on other visual containers.
